notes.title: First Patch | v1.0.3
notes.content:
-New Maps/Levels: Globus, Americas, Afrique, Eurasia
-Highlight where (and if) a unit can move when selected
-easy AI became easier (no more spamming on buildings)
-normal AI spawns fewer units out of nowhere
-VR Vive Input fixes
-Some VR movement and input improvements
-Tutorial UI less in the way
-Tutorial last step better explanation
-Hotkey to select unmoved units fixed (selected all but 1 before)
-Some other minor improvements and fixes...
